title: Teacher Theodore Pernell
summary: Theodore Pernell, brother of Alton, taught Justin, read anything and played gut-bucket style; he later had strokes.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Alton Pernell. Well this boy's name, his brother, Thereto Pernell. Yeah he was one of my teachers also. He taught me quite a bit because he had played much longer than I had and I used to go to his house for lessons. But he had a stroke about two years ago, I said two or three of them since that time.

And every time I'd go down there I used to go by and see him. But he was one fellow he really learned fast. I mean he's a good musician, he could read anything, he could put in front of him, he could play anything. And on top of that he had such a beautiful tone, beautiful tone. And I would say that he played a different style from anybody else because he didn't play Dixie or he didn't play progressive but his style was more or less on the gut bucket style. And that's what they used to feature a long time ago.
